The Sea Serpent guards the passage. Overcome it to reach the Isle of the East.

The quay is complete and the ships are waiting, as they once waited for the cedars of Lebanon, but no crew will make the crossing until the Sea Serpent that has swallowed every prior voyage is overcome. Find it in the Trials tab under Great Trials. The passage to the East opens the moment it falls.
Something ancient stirs in the depths of the isle. Assemble the full set of Ancient regalia to face it.

The salt spray fades and the fog lifts. Ahead: a bone-white shore, a forest carved with pale symbols, and further in, smoke curling from a peak that shouldn't be smoking. The old pilgrims were right: the Light rises in the East, and something ancient still keeps watch here.

Your skills, boosts and regalia from the City stay aboard the ship. Everything you level or craft on the isle grows a separate track of its own. Ancient regalia will carry back to the City; the City's power will not carry here.

Start with the Skills tab. Head to Quarrying or Timberwork to gather isle materials. Then check the Quests tab for your first objective, and visit the Keeper of Parchments in the City whenever a new fragment is revealed.
